title: Randomized and Oracle-Based Feasible Directions Methods for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Constrained Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.07691v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Minimizing nonsmooth nonconvex objectives over general convex sets using no derivatives of the objective, together with structural access to the constraint set, poses a fundamental geometric difficulty: at boundary points, the feasible direction cone may fail to be closed, preventing the construction of finite sets of search directions that capture all feasible descent directions. We develop a feasible-directions framework for problems structured as the difference between a continuously differentiable function and a convex function over a closed convex set, and access the objective without knowledge of its decomposition, through exact line searches along feasible segments. To address the geometric obstruction, we introduce $\eta$-feasible directions, which remain uniformly separated from the boundary of the feasible direction cone, enabling finite-direction search even in the presence of nonlinear constraints. translated_title: 针对非光滑非凸约束优化的随机化与基于预言机的可行方向方法
translated_abstract: 在一般凸集上最小化非光滑非凸目标函数，且不使用目标函数的导数、仅通过约束集的结构信息访问约束，这带来了一个根本性的几何难题：在边界点处，可行方向锥可能不是闭集，从而无法构造能够捕捉所有可行下降方向的有限搜索方向集合。我们针对在闭凸集上表现为连续可微函数与凸函数之差这一结构的问题，开发了一个可行方向框架，并在不知道目标函数分解形式的情况下，通过沿可行线段的精确线搜索来访问目标函数。为克服这一几何障碍，我们引入了η-可行方向，它与可行方向锥的边界保持一致分离，从而即使在存在非线性约束的情况下也能实现有限方向搜索。我们提出了两种算法...
tldr: 该论文引入η-可行方向（与可行方向锥边界保持一致分离的方向），克服了非光滑非凸约束优化中可行方向锥不封闭导致的几何难题，实现了无需目标导数、仅靠精确线搜索的有限方向搜索算法框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces η-feasible directions—uniformly separated from the boundary of the feasible direction cone—to overcome the geometric obstruction of non-closed feasible direction cones in nonsmooth nonconvex constrained optimization, enabling derivative-free finite-direction search methods via exact line searches.
